Binance Alpha Appreciation Airdrop & Service Updates

Rewards from the $350,000 Appreciation Airdrop will be available in eligible users’ Binance Alpha accounts or Binance Wallets.

No claiming or Alpha Points deduction is required. Each eligible user will receive rewards in one of the following tokens:

🔸 KGeN (KGEN)
🔸 Velo (VELO)
🔸 Velvet (VELVET)

Latest Service Updates

🔸 Alpha 2.0 Instant Orders: Available on all supported chains.
🔸 Alpha Deposits & Withdrawals: Available on BSC, ETH, BASE, and ARBITRUM networks, with the rest expected to follow soon.
🔸 Alpha Events: Airdrops and trading competitions will resume today. Stay tuned for upcoming announcements.

Thank you for your patience and continued support. We look forward to bringing you more exciting events soon!

A Special Thank You to Our Binance Alpha Community

Binance Alpha is currently undergoing a system upgrade. We want to take a moment to thank our community for your continued support and participation. Airdrops and trading competitions will return soon, and we look forward to bringing you more exciting events!

🎁 Exclusive Appreciation Airdrop

As a token of our gratitude, users with 200 or more Alpha Points as of November 6, 2026, at 23:59:59 UTC will be eligible to share a total airdrop reward pool worth $350,000.

🔸 No Alpha Points deduction
🔸 No FCFS or claiming required
🔸 Rewards will be automatically distributed to eligible users’ Alpha accounts

Further details regarding rewards and distribution timing will be announced soon.

Thank you for your patience and continued support. We look forward to bringing you more exciting events soon!
